create_body_data_provider: create a BodyDataProvider from an XSens NPZ file and optional GLB mesh file using the factory function
get_posed_skeleton_and_skin: get the posed skeleton wireframe and skin mesh vertices for a given timestamp in microseconds
get_T_w_h: get head pose SE3 transforms and timestamps over an optional nanosecond timespan for alignment computation
qt_to_se3: convert XSens quaternion and translation arrays into a list of SE3 transforms for all body parts
se3_to_skeleton: convert a list of SE3 transforms into a 3D wireframe numpy array for visualization
